type.Description: The type parameter is a simplified representation of the actual tympanogram curve. It provides an indication on the shape of the response curve and a clinical judgement on the normality of the result.

Levels.Ad: Presents a higher than expected mobility of the tympanic membrane
Levels.As: Presents a lower than expected mobility of the tympanic membrane
Levels.B: Presents a very low mobility of the tympanic membrane
Levels.C: Presents a lower fluid pressure in the middle ear than in the ear canal

tpp.Description: Maximal acoustic energy absorbance capacity of the tympanic membrane.

ecv.Description: Volume of the auditory canal between the probe and the tympanic membrane.

sc.Description: Maximal acoustic energy absorbance capacity of the middle ear ossicles.

tw.Description: Pressure level at 50% of the tympanogram's peak.
